notes: The one contested unit is s007: *of* could have been left as a supplied preposition with the כִּי marked `unrepresented`, but rule 53's closing paragraph governs an English rendering answering to another reading of a token the projection does carry, and the packet records no variant unit here.
Both marginal notes were read and set aside under rule 38; the printed text governs.
s012's suffix denotes Joram and not the relative's antecedent (the wounds), so rule 22's resumptive fusion does not reach it and it takes its own *him* under rule 18.
